verdict.rationale: Whether a chat product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, since some chat platforms are self-hostable and open source, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Slack's own source being published under any license. The public API-spec repo and the Bolt/SDK frameworks are developer building blocks, not the product's source, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
